## Workload

Hannah Lowe completed 157 reads during 270 hours of grading activity, equivalent to 0.6 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed by Priya Anand.

## Quality

A sample of 15 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 46.7 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with the review focusing on consistency between the original grading and the subsequent check. This outcome should be considered alongside the volume of work completed and the time available for each read. Priya Anand reviewed the workload and quality information for the period.
